full_judgment:
12. The learned Advocate Mr. Muhammad Ohiullah finally argued that the actual amount of loss occurred to the plaintiff has been assessed later through survey after the filling of the instant suit which come to Tk. 45,65,550 for which the plaintiff has obtained an amendment of the plaint and the same was substantiated by Ext. No 12(2). Therefore, the plaintiff is entitled to a decree on the enhanced claim as per amendment made. 

 21. It appears that the plaintiff had to pay the port demurrage charge up to the actual release of the containers and the plaintiff entitled to claim the rental compensation up to the actual release of the containers from the cargo from inside it. Therefore, upon calculating on the basis of plaintiff's original claim up to 21-3-2003, the amount, as this court finds that the plaintiff is entitled to a decree for such an amount of compensation comes to an amount of Tk. 24,00,000 (twenty four lacs) and accordingly the plaintiff is entitled to a decree for such an amount, as this court finds that the plaintiff successfully proved his claim upon cogent evidence. 

 22. In view of the discussion and reasons as above, the plaintiff is entitled to the decree as prayed for in modified amount. 

 25. That the suit be and hereby decreed for realization of compensation at an amount of taka 24,000,00 (twenty four lacs) by the plaintiff from the defendant No. 1. 

 26. The defendant No.1 is directed to pay compensation at an amount Tk. 24,00,000 (twenty four lacs) of the plaintiff within 60 (sixty) days from the signing of the decree. Failing which the plaintiff will be entitled to execute the decree against the deposited money now lying at the account of the Marshal of this court as aforesaid after deducting the amount of custom taxes and port dues for an amount of Tk. 33,29,718.71 and if the balance is not adequate for the satisfaction of the total amount of decree, the plaintiff will be further entitled to execute for the rest amount against the defendant No. 1, in other lawful manner.
